swim.name: SWIM2 ice consistency1-5m

provenance.transport: Provider ZIP contains SWIM2_c1_5.tif; direct source prefix and length independently verified

caveats: Composite ice evidence for1-5m sensing depth, not ice fraction, probability or precise burial depth.
Earth soil moisture and active-layer thickness are not the same variable; unmatched comparisons stay missing.
This coarse product does not establish local polygons or centimetre rocks.

scope: Lunar 2 km windows; Mars/Earth regional 20 km windows with 500 m grids. Fine landing slopes, rocks, ice and seasonal weather remain separate requirements.
